title: Question
description: An unresolved observation. Articulates what is unknown or uncertain and drives inquiry.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: The question being asked, stated concisely.

discussion.description: ID of the Discussion this question belongs to.

stems_from.description: IDs of Observations that motivate this question.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this question was recorded.

created_by.description: GitHub username of the contributor who posed this question.

answered_by.description: IDs of Hypotheses or Decisions that answer this question.

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
